title: A little Python before we build
heading: Before we build a game, let’s learn a little more Python.
description: You’ve already changed how a jump feels. Next, we’ll learn a few more Python ideas so you can build your game’s controls and rules.

scene.label: A short introduction to the Python lessons ahead.

explanation.title: Start small. Then make it yours.
explanation.text: First, let’s see how instructions work together. Later, you’ll use what you learn to make a game you can play and change.
